key_insight: The paper argues that table understanding can be done more effectively with structured text instead of table images. By combining table reconstruction and TabVQA around text-based representations, it reduces reliance on heavy vision-language encoders and better aligns with LLMs.
problem_solved: Current table understanding systems mostly use image-based VLMs, which are less scalable and harder to align with language models. This work addresses two core tasks: reconstructing tables from documents and answering questions about tables accurately.
method: Uses structured textual representations of tables rather than raw table images.
Introduces DELTA for table structure reconstruction.
Introduces TARQA for table question answering / table understanding.
Leverages LLM-friendly text formats to improve scalability and cross-language applicability.
impact: This approach can simplify table intelligence pipelines and make them more efficient for document AI systems. For practitioners, it offers a path to stronger table understanding without depending on expensive vision-heavy models.

paper_title: Tables Decoded: DELTA for Structure, TARQA for Understanding
paper_authors: Jahanvi Rajput, Dhruv Kudale, Saikiran Kasturi, Utkarsh Verma, Ganesh Ramakrishnan
